name: The Holy Spirit
title: God's Spirit and the Advocate
summary: The Holy Spirit is the third person of the triune God. The Spirit was active from creation, inspired prophets and kings throughout the Old Testament, and was poured out on all believers at Pentecost. The Holy Spirit guides, comforts, convicts of sin, and equips believers with power and spiritual gifts.

keyEvents.title: The Spirit hovers over the waters at creation
keyEvents.description: At the beginning of the world, God's Spirit hovered over the waters, active in creation from the very first moment.

keyEvents.title: The Spirit Equips Leaders in the Old Testament
keyEvents.description: The Holy Spirit came upon chosen individuals like David to equip them for service. When Samuel anointed David, the Lord's Spirit came upon him from that day forward.

keyEvents.title: Jesus' Promise of the Advocate
keyEvents.description: Jesus promised his disciples that he would send the Holy Spirit as the Advocate, who would guide them into all truth and remind them of everything Jesus had said.

keyEvents.title: The Outpouring of the Spirit on Pentecost
keyEvents.description: On the day of Pentecost, the Holy Spirit was poured out upon believers in Jerusalem with the sound of a mighty wind and tongues like fire. This marked the beginning of the church age.

keyEvents.title: The Fruit and Gifts of the Spirit
keyEvents.description: Paul teaches that the Holy Spirit produces fruit in the lives of believers—love, joy, peace—and gives spiritual gifts for the building up of the church.

keyEvents.title: The Spirit as Seal and Guarantee
keyEvents.description: The Holy Spirit is given as a seal and guarantee of the believers' inheritance, confirming that they belong to God and securing their future redemption.
